n675a88fef4.headline: The CEPB suggests reforms in 7 areas to overcome the crisis
n675a88fef4.summary: The Confederation of Private Entrepreneurs of Bolivia proposed structural reforms in seven fiscal areas to the government to address the economic crisis sustainably.
n675a88fef4.why: Private sector reform proposals can influence government policy and economic recovery strategies in Bolivia.
